crons.comment: Keeps a Free-tier Supabase project from pausing after a week idle, which would look like an outage mid-interview.

Drains the job queue (evaluations, JD matches), expires token lots, purges 14-day-old proctoring snapshots. Vercel Hobby allows 2 crons at daily frequency, so this slot does all the periodic work. On Pro, split drain-jobs back out at */5 and leave maintenance daily.
